title: Payment risk investigation desk
problem: Payment operations teams face high alert volumes and fragmented policy context. Analysts need consistent triage signals and cited reasons to prioritize investigation without treating a model score as proof of fraud.
solution: Payment-risk triage with logistic regression, held-out precision metrics, grounded LLM decisions, bounded RAG prompts, audit storage, MCP and Docker.
description: Payment-risk triage with logistic regression, held-out precision metrics, grounded LLM decisions, bounded RAG prompts, audit storage, MCP and Docker.
retrieval_query: payment fraud velocity new account investigation
data_formula: Labels come from a noisy logistic function of amount, velocity, account age and location distance. No customer data, protected attributes or genuine fraud outcomes are included.
